title: Al-Atash Di Sada Bulund Keytee
body:
Al-Atash Di Sada Bulund Keytee, Ja’an Sakina Dey Veer Neh Lokho.
<<DIVIDER>>
Pyaas Masoom Di Bujaaee Hai, Shaqeh Hurmal Deh Teer Neh Lokho.
<<DIVIDER>>
Aidaa Tereh Noukan Walaah Teer Aaya, Kaul Keh Moo Halaq Teh Jaaleyaa Hai
Khoon Nadik Quran Bachreh Dah, Medeh Mola Neh Moo Teh Maleyaa Hai
Hurmala Di Kamaan Tour Dithee, Muskara Keh Sagheir Neh Lokho.
<<DIVIDER>>
Khusk Hountaan Dhi Muskrahat Deh, Haan Trazoo Teh Teer Toleyaa Hai
Uni Ramazan Waalay Lafzaan Daa, Garm Raita’aan Te Raaz Koleyaa Hai
Fuzt-o-Bay Rab-e-Kaaba Furmayaa, Keevain Mola Ameer Neh Lokho.
<<DIVIDER>>
Aien Vi Dastoor Kul Zamaneh Dah, Koi Walid Janaza Chaein Da Nai
Paawain Pardes Vich Howeh Kazia, Pyoon Putar Di Qabar Burehnda Nai
Keewain Asghar Koon Aap Dafnayaa, Medeh Mola Shabbir Neh Lokho.
<<DIVIDER>>
Keewain Medhi Rubab Bibi Neh, Duji Waari Shaheed Laal Dihtaa
Treji Waari Buland Nezey Teh, Pardah Quran Ba Kamala Dhita
Haq Ho Mehdaan Vich Hai Manwayaa, Mustapha Di Taseer Neh Lokho.
